#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 10



  graph_data <- targets::tar_read(data_vaccination_coverage_raw) %>%
                      filter(intervention_priority == "contact", intervention_setting == "home.social.sexual") %>%
    group_by(vax_place) %>%
                      summarize(count = n()) %>%
                      ungroup() %>%
                      arrange(-count) %>%
                      mutate(community = factor(vax_place, unique(vax_place))) %>%
                      mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) %>%
                      mutate(cumprop = cumsum(prop)) %>%
                      mutate(group = "Group A") %>%
                      mutate(group = ifelse(cumprop > 0.33, "Group B", group)) %>%
                      mutate(group = ifelse(cumprop > 0.66, "Group C", group)) %>%
                      mutate(group = lag(group)) %>%
                      mutate(group = ifelse(is.na(group), "Group A", group)) 
  
  

 
 
 map_graph <- mpxnyc::community_sf_obj %>%
                   left_join(graph_data) %>%
                   ggplot() +
                          geom_sf(fill = "grey") +
                         geom_sf(aes(fill = group, alpha = group), color = "white") +
                         theme_void() +
                         theme(
                           axis.text = element_blank(),
                           legend.position = "bottom"
                         ) +
                         scale_fill_manual(
                           "Intervention Group", 
                                          values = c(
                                                        "Group A" = dark_pink, 
                                                        "Group B" = dark_blue, 
                                                        "Group C" = light_purple
                                                        ), 
                                           na.value = "grey",
                           na.translate = FALSE
                                           ) + 
                         scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Group A" = 1, "Group B" = 1, "Group C" = 0.5)) +
                         labs(
                                title     = captions_and_titles("barmapcoverage")$title,
                                subtitle  = captions_and_titles("barmapcoverage")$subtitle,
                                caption   = captions_and_titles("barmapcoverage")$caption %>% str_wrap(110) %>% paste0("\n\n", captions_and_titles("common_caption") )
                                ) +
   guides(alpha = "none")
                   
  

 

 
apply_style_spacing_remainder(map_graph, caption_hjust = 0)
